summary: Complaints centre on broken and waterlogged roads, drains and the sugar mill dues in Bijnor city and its district, while residents mainly appreciate better road connectivity and health services.
identity_source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_constituencies_of_the_Uttar_Pradesh_Legislative_Assembly (row: 22 Bijnor, None, Bijnor district); https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bijnor_Assembly_constituency (extent: KC Mandawar, Bijnor, Dara Nagar, Mandawar NP, Jhalu NP and Bijnor MB of Bijnor Tehsil)

positives.english: Road connectivity has improved a lot
positives.hindi: सड़कों की कनेक्टिविटी काफी अच्छी हुई है
positives.basis: Local resident Neeraj, quoted in Amar Ujala's Bijnor Vidhan Sabha issues feature, says roads connectivity has improved well; bridges, highway and road building eased travel (Bijnor city feature, not a road-by-road report)

positives.english: Health facilities have improved a lot
positives.hindi: स्वास्थ्य सुविधाओं में काफी सुधार हुआ है
positives.basis: Resident Faheem, quoted in the same Amar Ujala feature, says health facilities have improved considerably (general statement, no named facility)

positives.english: Chowks in the city have been beautified
positives.hindi: शहर के चौराहे अब चमक गए हैं
positives.basis: Amar Ujala reports Bijnor's intersections have been beautified (headline: 'चमक गए चौराहे'); the same report says the roads leading to them are still damaged

positives.english: Local issues are raised by the MLA and some development has happened
positives.hindi: विधायक ने क्षेत्र के मुद्दे ऊपर तक उठाए, कुछ काम भी हुए
positives.basis: In the Amar Ujala feature, an unnamed resident says the MLA raised local issues at state level and development work followed; other residents said some work is still pending

positives.english: Nine of the district's ten sugar mills have paid cane dues on time
positives.hindi: जिले की दस में से नौ चीनी मिलों ने भुगतान कर दिया है
positives.basis: District-level: Amar Ujala says nine of the district's ten sugar mills have paid; only Bilai mill is still owing (positive for farmers, not AC-specific)

negatives.english: Sugarcane dues of Rs 41.98 crore are still pending at Bilai sugar mill
negatives.hindi: बिलाई चीनी मिल पर 41.98 करोड़ गन्ना भुगतान बकाया है
negatives.basis: District-level, not AC-specific: Amar Ujala says Bilai mill owes Rs 41.98 crore and is making partial payments; farmers plan a sit-in and affidavits. Mill location and whether it lies in AC 22 is not stated in the source

negatives.english: Potholes and broken divider on Nagina Road, Chakkar Road and Jaji Chowk make driving dangerous
negatives.hindi: नगीना रोड और चक्कर रोड पर गड्ढे, जजी चौक का डिवाइडर टूटा, हादसे हो रहे हैं
negatives.basis: Bijnor city: Amar Ujala reports the Nagina Road is badly potholed up to WKIT, Chakkar Road potholes so deep bricks were dumped, and Shastri to Jaji Chowk divider broken with vehicles climbing it at night causing accidents; EE Hemant Pratap Singh said Nagina and Chakkar roads will be repaired after rains

negatives.english: Awas Vikas, Nai Basti and Post Office area get waterlogged in rain
negatives.hindi: आवास विकास, नई बस्ती और पोस्ट ऑफिस में बारिश में पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Bijnor city: Amar Ujala reports waterlogging in Awas Vikas, Nai Basti, Post Office area and other places left people troubled; residents say they have faced waterlogging for 30 years; EO Megha Gupta said water is being pumped out

negatives.english: Bijnor to Daranagar Ganj road widening is stuck for want of bitumen
negatives.hindi: बिजनौर से दारानगर गंज तक सड़क चौड़ीकरण तारकोल न मिलने से अटका है
negatives.basis: Bijnor to Daranagar Ganj stretch (about 10 km, 7 m to 10 m widening, about Rs 18 crore); Dara Nagar is named in the AC extent on Wikipedia. Amar Ujala says Executive Engineer Hemant Pratap Singh said work stopped for lack of bitumen, pits dug on both sides are troubling drivers

negatives.english: Newly built drains in Mandawar collapsed, residents allege poor quality
negatives.hindi: मंडावर में लाखों की नालियां ढह गईं, घटिया सामग्री का आरोप है
negatives.basis: Mandawar Nagar Panchayat (named in AC extent on Wikipedia): about 14 drains costing roughly Rs 1 crore under urban drainage scheme; one drain near Bijli Ghar collapsed, residents allege substandard material and blame the contractor and NP officials; SDM Smriti Mishra said an inquiry will be done (allegation, not proven)

notes: Identity confirmed from Wikipedia list (No. 22 Bijnor, reserved None, district Bijnor); AC extent per Wikipedia: Bijnor tehsil, Bijnor MB, Mandawar NP, Jhalu NP, Dara Nagar, KC Mandawar. Search snippets said Nagina is a district sub-division, not the AC name. Positives are thin: 4 of 5 come from one Amar Ujala feature (31 Aug 2026) and the 9/10 mill payment figure is district-level. Bilai sugar mill location not stated in any source fetched; AC membership unconfirmed. Kadrabad-Hidayatpur-Pattharwala road (Amar Ujala, 5 Oct 2026, 30-year potholes) left out of the list because its membership in AC 22 is not confirmed; a field check could add it. Nurpur (Dhelli Ahir) and Jaleelpur/Bahsuma-Thakurdwara, Sherkot and Kiratpur reports are outside this AC and were not used. Field check suggested: Bijnor-Daranagar Ganj road status after rains, Mandawar drain inquiry outcome, Shastri to Jaji divider. Electors figure on Wikipedia (317,824) is from 2012 and not used.
